versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The Com High Proxy shall provide the functions for invalidation request of a signal(group)s, according to [SWS_SwCluC_02611], once per configured SwCluCComProxyBaseSocket . At the EcucPartition where the SwCluCNativeBswApi is set to true , the API is provided with the original Mip Com . For all the other SwCluCComProxyBaseSocket instances, the Mip Com is replaced by Com_<EcucPartition.ShortName> .
